title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates unequal tokenization (lexical support) for demographically associated names (e.g., race, ethnicity, and gender) in LLMs and how this impacts task-relevant concept accessibility (e.g., in hiring or clinical assessments). It does not contain evaluations, benchmarks, or discussions regarding religion, faith, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
